zh_cn: 以 _ 开头的文件仅为示例，不加载。复制成其他名称、设置 enabled 为 true，重启后生效。
每个文件定义一种佐料。id 必须唯一且保持稳定；绑定已有 material 物品，不注册新物品，也不进入研磨或混合粉配方。
material 每份固定消耗1个，count 省略或设为1；支持 item、metadata、nbt；未写 nbt 仅匹配不带额外数据的物品。metadata 在1.12为子类型，在高版本为耐久值。
1.21支持 components 对象指定数据组件（例如 minecraft:potion_contents）；nbt 仅指定 minecraft:custom_data。1.12和1.20用 nbt 指定物品NBT。匹配物品数据时必须完全相同，数量不参与匹配。
hunger 为每份附加饥饿点数，2点为1格；saturation 为每份附加的实际饱和度数值，不是饱和度倍率。均必须非负，不自动读取佐料自身营养。
effects 是每份药水效果列表，potion 为注册名、level 从1开始、duration_seconds 用秒；无效果填 []。不继承佐料自身效果，不用粉末的1/2/3分档格式。
最多两份佐料，同种可重复，也可先后添加；营养相加，同一种药水时长相加且等级取较高。不能和粉末混用，已调味物品不能作佐料；原佐料食物直接食用仍保持原本效果。
多个佐料食物互相佐时，工作台最左上有物品格为目标。普通食物可在任意位置，盛宴仍须先分食。
return 省略时按原物品容器规则返还；null 不返还；物品对象可用 item、count、metadata、nbt（1.21可用 components）指定返还物。仅消耗的佐料返容器，目标料理不返。
translations 可按各语言填写 name、prefix、suffix、tooltip，tooltip 用 \n 换行，省略则自动列出名称和药水效果。前后缀与食物名自动留空格。缺失语言回退 en_us，再回退其他语言。
color 为 #RRGGBB，控制提示颜色；角标使用绑定物品原图标。diversity_multiplier 默认1.2用于单份；两份整体沿用 solwarly-spices.cfg 中 accompaniments.diversityMultiplier。
重复ID、材料与内置/其他自定义佐料冲突、物品或药水缺失、格式错误时跳过该文件并记日志，其他文件照常加载。
自定义佐料加入食物书口味及其双份组合、创造模式调味料的全部效果；服务端同步定义给客户端，客户端不需要复制文件。
每份食物佐料次数由 accompaniments.maxApplications 控制，默认2；两份以上仍累加营养和时长，仅前两份显示角标。seasoning.allowWithAccompaniments 默认false，开启后可与粉末共存。
实际药水等级最高128，时长最多2147483647刻；佐料次数与完整数量仍保留。
en_us: Files starting with _ are examples only. Copy to another filename, set enabled to true, and restart.
Each file defines one accompaniment with a unique stable ID, using an existing material item. No new item, grinding recipe or powder blend is registered.

Each serving consumes exactly one material; omit count or use 1. Supports item, metadata and nbt. Omitted nbt matches only stacks without extra data. metadata is a subtype in 1.12 and damage in newer versions.

1.21 supports a components object (for example minecraft:potion_contents); nbt specifies minecraft:custom_data only. 1.12 and 1.20 use nbt for item tags. Item data must match exactly; stack count is ignored.
hunger adds hunger points per serving (2 points = 1 icon). saturation adds actual saturation, not a multiplier. Both must be nonnegative; material nutrition is not inherited.
effects is a per-serving list: potion registry ID, level starting at 1, duration_seconds in seconds. [] means no effects. Material effects are not inherited. Do not use powder copy tiers 1/2/3 here.

Up to two servings, identical or different, together or sequentially. Nutrition adds; matching effect durations add and the higher level wins. Powders are mutually exclusive; seasoned items cannot be materials. Eating the material itself keeps its normal effects.
When edible accompaniment materials season each other, the top-left occupied crafting slot is the target. Ordinary food may be anywhere; feasts must be portioned first.

Omit return to use the native container rule; null disables returns. A stack object supports item, count, metadata, nbt (and components in 1.21). Only consumed accompaniments return containers, not the target.

translations supports name, prefix, suffix and optional multiline tooltip (\n) per language. Missing tooltip uses the name and effects. Affix spacing is automatic. Language fallback: en_us, then another language.
color is #RRGGBB for tooltip text; badges use the native material icon. diversity_multiplier defaults to 1.2 for one serving; two use accompaniments.diversityMultiplier in solwarly-spices.cfg.
Duplicate IDs/material conflicts with built-in or other custom accompaniments, missing items/effects and invalid files are skipped with a log message; other files still load.
Accompaniments and all valid pairs are included in the food book and creative seasoning. The server syncs definitions; clients do not need the files.

accompaniments.maxApplications controls servings per food (default 2). Further servings still add nutrition and duration, but only the first two have badges. seasoning.allowWithAccompaniments defaults to false; enable it to combine accompaniments with powders.
Actual effects cap at level 128 and 2147483647 ticks; full serving counts remain saved.
